mainEntity.name: What is the difference between custom and pre-fabricated bathroom cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom bathroom cabinets are built to your specific dimensions, design preferences, and material choices, offering maximum flexibility and a perfect fit for unique spaces. They often come with a higher price tag and longer lead time. Pre-fabricated, or stock, cabinets are mass-produced in standard sizes and styles, making them more affordable and readily available. While they offer less customization, they can be a great option for standard bathroom layouts and tighter budgets. We can help you weigh the pros and cons for your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom cabinets are built to specific designs and dimensions, while pre-fabricated cabinets are standard sizes, offering different levels of flexibility and cost.
